# decision-012: Implement source-aware acceptance as a transport-independent service over validated media contracts, conservative stable-identity resolution, explicit unresolved-source selection, and atomic durable handoff consumption.

## Rationale and consequences

Submission, projection and bound one-use handoff consumption are atomic. Provenance uses strict nested schemas at service and repository boundaries. Telegram-native source_media_id equals file_unique_id in the telegram provider namespace. Evidence dataclasses assert a trusted adapter result, not authenticated validation; submission handlers remain unexposed. Disposable PostgreSQL CI covers real migrations, rollback, uniqueness and concurrent handoff consumption.
